title: MailAgentInbox
description: An address an agent can read, on the person's own domain: <agent>.<user>@openvibe.email. The mail lands in the person's mailbox, like every other address OpenVibe.Mail hands out; what makes it an agent's inbox is that the service reads it back for the agent acting for that person. One agent has one inbox: asking twice returns the same resource.

id.description: The inbox id. Opaque outside OpenVibe.Mail.

owner.description: The Network subject id of the person whose mailbox receives the agent's mail.

agent_id.description: The agent's name in the address, lowercased and cleaned (letters, digits and hyphens).

address.description: The agent's address. In M1 the user part is the person's Network username, falling back to their mailbox local when that readable address is already taken.

created_at.description: When the inbox was made, ISO 8601 UTC.
